title: Fix non-functional button and select dropdown in AdminCommentsTab

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Create Comment List' button to properly handle click events and create comment lists
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the button triggers comment list creation
Loading state is shown during creation
Success feedback is displayed after creation
New list appears in the dropdown after creation
Error messages are shown if creation fails

file_operations.description: Fix the create comment list button click handler by ensuring proper event binding and state management. Connect the button's onClick handler to the createCommentList mutation from useAdminComments hook. Add loading state display during creation, success feedback after creation completes, and error handling for failed operations. Ensure the newly created list appears in the available lists dropdown after successful creation through proper query invalidation.

requirements.summary: Fix the action select dropdown to properly handle change events and trigger appropriate actions
acceptanceCriteria: Select dropdown responds to change events
Changing selection triggers the appropriate action
Selected value is properly stored in component state
Dependent UI elements update based on selection
Error handling is in place for failed actions

file_operations.description: Fix the action select dropdown's onChange handler to properly capture and store the selected value in component state. Ensure the selected action (delete list, reset list, or other operations) is triggered when the dropdown value changes. Add proper error handling for failed actions and update dependent UI elements based on the current selection. Connect the dropdown to the appropriate mutations from useAdminComments hook (deleteList, resetList) and ensure proper query invalidation after actions complete.
